description: This Java class defines the response object for a 'ModifySubject' command within the Eclipse Ditto project, handling JSON serialization/deserialization, and providing factory methods for creating instances with various parameters.

classes.name: ModifySubjectResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a 'ModifySubject' command, with JSON serialization/deserialization, factory methods, and response details.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a 'created' response with PolicyId, Label, Subject, and headers.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a 'modified' response with PolicyId, Label, SubjectId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or object with associated headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label of the policy entry.

methods.name: getSubjectCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Subject, if any.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity as JSON value, if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with updated Ditto headers.
